description: This file defines API routes for task management in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints to list, create, update, patch, and delete 'Task' objects, handling user authentication and database interactions.

methods.name: TaskOut _task_to_out(t: Task)
methods.description: Converts a Task model instance to a TaskOut schema object for API responses.

methods.name: list[TaskOut] list_tasks( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all tasks for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: TaskOut create_task( payload: TaskCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new task for the current user, validating priority.

methods.name: TaskOut update_task( task_id: str, payload: TaskUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to replace/update an existing task with provided data.

methods.name: TaskOut patch_task( task_id: str, payload: TaskPatchCompleted, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to toggle the completion status of an existing task.

methods.name: Response delete_task( task_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a task by ID.
